request: Run the size-reduction stage on 206 replies too, because our download service wants smaller pieces over the network.

source.request: Run the size-reduction stage on 206 replies too, because our download service wants smaller pieces over the network.
source.settled: Compression middleware skips responses with status 206 to preserve byte-range semantics.
source.why: Compressing partial responses would restore the byte-range corruption the status guard prevents.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
